compose_visibility_hint: Choose who can see this post.
compose_hint: Markdown is supported. Use @username to mention someone and #tag to add a topic.
feed_subtitle: Posts from the people you follow and the wider community.
guest_body: Log in or create an account to post, follow people and react to posts.
no_posts: No posts yet. Be the first to share something.
no_hashtag_posts: No posts for this hashtag yet.
about_body: A small social network built on bulletinbored. Follow people, share posts and join the conversation.
private_profile_body: Only the owner can see this profile's posts.
social_settings_hint: Customise how your profile looks and who can see it.
display_name_hint: Shown next to your username on your profile.
profile_privacy_hint: Public profiles follow each post's visibility. Followers-only profiles show social posts to followers. Private profiles hide social posts from everyone except you. Classic forum threads keep their own forum visibility.
cover_hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
account_settings_hint: Change your username, e-mail, password or avatar in the core profile editor.
action_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
report_sent: Thanks, your report has been sent to the moderators.
report_failed: The report could not be sent.
report_rate_limited: You are reporting too fast. Please try again later.
reports_subtitle: Review reports submitted by the community.
block_confirm: Block this user? Their posts will disappear from your feed.
compose_failed: The post could not be published.
compose_rate_limited: You are posting too fast. Please try again later.
profile_rate_limited: You are updating your profile too fast. Please try again later.
bio_too_long: The bio is too long (max 500 characters).
cover_invalid: The cover must be a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 4 MB.
admin_subtitle: Configure the social mode, review reports and manage social data.
admin_core_identity_body: The social look (palette, radii and navbar) is provided by the core freshbored theme whenever a page runs in social mode. There is no separate social theme to install.
mode_forum_hint: The home page stays the classic forum. The social feed is available at /social.
mode_social_hint: The home page becomes the social feed. The classic forum stays available at /forum.
mode_both_hint: Classic forum at /, social feed at /social.
include_forum_threads: Include forum threads in the feed
allow_public_feed: Allow guests to read the public feed
social_email_notifications: Send e-mail notifications for social actions
dependencies_hint: editbored and bellbored must be installed and enabled before socialbored can run. textmebored is optional and only adds direct messages.
deps_required: Enable editbored and bellbored before switching to social mode.
delete_data_hint: Delete all social metadata (profiles, follows, blocks, mutes, reactions, bookmarks, reposts, hashtags and reports). Core threads and posts are not deleted, and the core thread/profile visibility is left untouched, so private and followers-only content stays hidden. Type DELETE to confirm.
admin_rate_limited: You are performing too many social admin operations. Please try again later.
cleanup_confirm: Remove social rows whose user, thread or post no longer exists?
blocked_profile_body: You can't view this profile because of a block.
followers_profile_body: Follow this person to see their posts and replies.
